text:
I'm sorry your plant arrived damaged—that's frustrating. Yes, you can get a replacement.

Since you're reporting this **3 days after delivery**, you've unfortunately passed the **48-hour DOA window** for damage claims. However, the good news is your plant is now covered under our **30-day Plant Care Guarantee** (or 90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member).

To claim a replacement, go to "My Orders" and submit a claim with **at least two photos** (one of the whole plant and a close-up of the snapped stem). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days** and approve a free replacement of the same plant—you don't need to send the damaged plant back.

Do you have photos ready to submit?
